name: Music Studio
description: Take a song idea to three 30-second sketches with ElevenLabs Music or Lyria, keep them in a library, and (in later versions) arrange, mix, master and film it. Every paid step waits for your confirm.

panels.label: Music Studio
panels.description: Sketch song ideas and keep them in a library

settings.label: ElevenLabs key
settings.description: From elevenlabs.io, Developers, API keys. Used for Music v2.5 and to show your credits.

settings.label: Gemini key
settings.description: From aistudio.google.com, Get API key. Used for Lyria 3 Clip and Lyria 3.5.

settings.label: ffmpeg path
settings.description: Mix renders the final mix with ffmpeg. Leave empty to use ffmpeg from the PATH.

settings.label: Library folder
settings.description: Where each project's folder is kept. Made on the first sketch.
